body:
Recovered the modern shell service boundary and implemented typed ShellServiceEnvelope plus update support in inspect-service-message in `3b89ee92c1ac0a23d0ab41fa654b7b02536a830a`.

Source evidence: nine Pipeline shell-payload constructor call sites. Modern PreviewShellModernUpdaterInterface.update copies ShellUpdatePayload into ServiceMessage.Content, injects tag5 (update), calls shell transport Future send and destroys temporary Content.2208 instruction bytes independently compared; Pipeline/Platforms/Messaging hashes and UUIDs pinned. REA6.2.0 expected package/path/catalog aligned, closed/provider null. This identifies the immediate boundary, not observed runtime updater/daemon dispatch.

Actual native ServiceMessage decode/encode composition:378 attempts,137 accepts/241 errors.131 deterministic portable cases;6 inherited multi-key incremental ambiguity restrictions. Optional identifier is inside payload under __unique_service_message_identifier; absent/empty/Unicode qualify, malformed present non-Strings reject. Canonical shell fields compose with identifier. New requests use the shared process-local identifier sequence. The generic ServiceEnvelope subset remains separate.

392 full Rust tests,378 CLI attempts,131 actual WASI canonical runs,131 Foundation reparses and disposable fresh replay pass. WASM SHA256912d70691e7fb6e356cb68b804d34e95f6b5ef1e70593ee008df85ee223c4200. Native layout kind512,size233,stride240,align8,fields0/16;137 message/137 output plist destructor invocations and241 error releases return, without unique nested final-release claims. Nested nonfinite Real regression fixed using existing qualified codec-scoped writer; generic writer unchanged. Initial copied-symbol guard SIGTRAP before decoder, fresh build60s deadline and precommit public-log whitespace correction retained. Native calls8s, Swift compilers30s,WASI10s; replay bounded180s.

Evidence: https://github.com/aspauldingcode/xcpreviewer-rs/tree/development/research/evidence/native-shell-service-2026-10-26 (seal `30bbdc540381c6b050edcb91e960001c57767b2a7aa459022286ad1bfea44411`). Original helpers/owned fixtures/sanitized findings only; raw Apple instructions/symbol dumps local ignored. Serial controller; full-index user staged work preserved. Actual modern updater transport invocation, daemon routing, update application, Canvas scene/render/interaction, kernel/provider resource settlement and both milestones remain incomplete. Next qualify actual modern updater send using an owned transport witness, then correlate routing/application.
